name: Trials
title: Trials: made-up testers try each change on their phone before it ships, a job at a time, and every problem they hit is kept, discussed and decided

permissions: after a run of gene therapy proves a change that a person sees, has a made-up person (a tester, the person's default unless another is asked for by name) try it in that run's own test world, through a headless browser at a phone's size, seeing only the screen, its words and what can be pressed
asks the model on "Trials tester" what the persona sees, thinks and does at each step, and the model on "Trials: the same problem again" whether a problem found is one already on the list
keeps each trial's steps, screenshots and ending, and one list of problems, each counted again when seen again and closed only when a later trial gets past it
puts the owner's own confusions on the same list: a term they ask the meaning of in a chat, or saying something in Rouh is confusing
starts a run that only runs a trial when the person asks for one ("trial this page with Boris", or Run this trial again), which stands up a test world and changes no code
after a third try that still fails, posts one notice saying the change shipped anyway

lets Rouh and every agent (rouh-trial) run a trial, read trials and problems, put a problem on the list by hand, add a sighting, open a closed one again, read the personas and set who tries every change

keeps the person's testers (`trial_testers`): adds, changes and removes (archives) them from the Testers page, and writes a whole profile from one sentence with the model on "Trials: writing a new tester"

pauses and resumes a tester, or all testing at once (`trials_paused`), from the Testers page, a tester's page or the trials tool: a paused tester starts no new try of any kind, and a build that meets the pause skips its trial (`SKIPPED: skipped: tester paused`, exit 0) without failing
keeps every try in a job (`trial_jobs`), what is being tested

keeps a discussion on each problem (`trial_notes`), where the model on "Trials: talking a problem over" answers the owner with the problem, its screenshot and its try, and the owner's verdict: not a problem, won't fix, decided how to fix it, or sent as feedback to Gene therapy, filling and sending its drawer with the report and screenshot
touches.remove: Delete this manifest, rouh/trials/ (the code and its personas), rouh/models/trials.py and its import, rouh/web/trials.py and its addresses in urls.py, trialspage.js and trialspage.css and their lines in index.html, its page in evolutionpage.js, app/runs.js and app/address.js, bin/rouh-trial, the trials tool in tools.py and toolsearch.py, the Trials section in agent_instructions.py, the trial stage in starting.py, the owner's confusions in brain.py, its four uses in modeldefaults.py and model_standard.json, `window.RouhGeneTherapy` in app/gene_therapy.js, the screenshots under the data folder's trials/, and drop the tables trials, trial_steps, trial_problems, trial_sightings, trial_testers, trial_jobs and trial_notes with a migration.
